notes: The universe remains degenerate in the ways integration round 2 recorded, and w107 closes none of them. Two measured findings worth reading beside this gate. First, the v1 rectangle cannot make food: of the 59 authored resource-yield effects at target universe, exactly five sit in a v1 cell and all five route to stone, because terram is the only material-bearing form among the twelve. Every ruleset comparison taken inside the v1 rectangle is therefore an argument about stone. Second, stated carefully because the sloppy version has misled several readers: advanceConstruction and applyLibraryUpkeep both have production callers in world-step.ts and run every tick, so construction is NOT inert. What is measured over 1200 ticks of the reference universe with zero god actions is constructionStoneOwed 0, buildProgressAdded 0, universitiesCompleted 0, against exactly one university -- the seeded academy, already complete. Founding a site is a god action, so with no actions submitted there is nothing to advance and stone is never spent. Those two facts together are why the campaign-plan W90 measurement of a yield-maximising ruleset was null by construction of its arms rather than for want of a mechanism: the arms could only make stone, and stone had nothing to buy.
rationale: w107 added GOAL.applyMagic: a mage may spend the month casting one resource-yield node she holds at the world, which costs her that month and her rations and puts materials into the stocks. contentRevision moved 162f80bf169296d0e5fd516cc3c5257a -> d4e3047657b4fa8a1a74e1d52f9f5c86 because autonomy-weight.json gained apply-output-per-month (fp 64) and apply-ration-per-month (fp 4), so the gate refuses on provenance before it reads a metric. UNLIKE THE LAST THREE RE-RECORDS, METRICS MOVED, AND ON PURPOSE. A month spent applying is a month not spent studying, so the knowledge series fall and no population series does: at the five-year gate referenceNodesKnown -1.17 (-10.6 SE), referenceKnowledgeInstances -33.14 (-15.4 SE), referenceLibraryDepth -1.465 (-6.7 SE), while referencePopulation, referencePeakPopulation and referenceGrimoires all pass. The horizon gate shows the same shape and moves referenceNodesGainedFinalQuarter UP +0.685 (+6.5 SE) -- universes are still learning at the end of a run that used to have plateaued. That trade is the mechanism, not a regression, and the numbers are why this file is re-recorded rather than its tolerances widened. NO NEW RNG STREAM was added (goal selection reuses stream 7 keyed per mage, so contracts.md 6 re-baseline event is avoided), NO WORLD SCHEMA REVISION was needed, and NO GOLDEN FIXTURE WAS REGENERATED. This file is a measurement, not a balance claim: release-plan.md forbids a balance claim before 0.5.0. Both magnitudes ship tuningStatus untuned and are the first two numbers a sweep should move. Record: balance/results-w107-apply-before.txt and balance/results-w107-apply-after.txt.
